summary: Apple's neural network training framework over BNNS and Metal Performance Shaders. The official page marks it deprecated in favour of Accelerate, Metal Performance Shaders and Core ML. BifrOSt has no ML training API in its SDK; ML inference work lives in the separate hamr project, which is not a BifrOSt desktop feature.

features.note: data object for the framework; no SDK tensor type
neural network layer graph; no counterpart in SDK or ui
graph training on CPU and GPU; deprecated upstream and out of scope for a desktop shell
